responsibility: Implements the AMD FMA4 intrinsic interface for x86, exposing four-operand fused multiply-add/subtract operations on 128-bit and 256-bit floating-point vectors. The header conditionally enables fma4, builds on the SSE4A/SSE headers, and maps the published FMA4 intrinsic names to the corresponding GCC builtins, including positive, negative, add-sub, and sub-add variants for scalar and packed float and double types.
